atlases.prompt: Create a production pixel-art RPG SKILL ICON ATLAS for a 2D Vietnamese cultivation webgame. Crisp hand-drawn pixel art, limited per-icon palette, no smooth painting, no typography, no numbers. Each icon square is a dark charcoal tile with a thin muted gold pixel border and ONE large recognizable centered skill symbol. Same framing and contrast throughout. No subject crosses a cell boundary. No gutters between tiles. Icon order is row-major left to right top to bottom. Distinct silhouettes for every listed skill, never the same symbol simply recolored. Motifs must communicate the action (blades/slashes, barriers/shields, roots/vines, healing, storm/burst, or passive inner cultivation). EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows in a square image, equal square cells. Element theme COMMON: muted jade, pearl and gold. Required first 3 cells: 1: Thiền Cảnh, restore_mp (THIEN_CANH); 2: Ngũ Hành Kích, elemental strike (NGU_HANH_KICH); 3: Thanh Tâm, cleanse (THANH_TAM). Fill remaining cells with unique spare COMMON talismans; no text anywhere. Chunky pixels remain legible at 32x32.
